description: Specific prohibited behaviors with detection patterns. Used by audit agents and CI validators.

prohibited-behaviors.name: Invented Examples
prohibited-behaviors.description: Adding code examples, error messages, or use cases not present in the source document
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: example code block with no corresponding source line

prohibited-behaviors.name: Term Invention
prohibited-behaviors.description: Using technical terms, function names, or API names not found in the source
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: technical noun not in source document and not in data/vocabulary/

prohibited-behaviors.name: Structural Hallucination
prohibited-behaviors.description: Claiming a section, heading, or list item exists when it is not in the source
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: heading or list item text not found verbatim in source pages

prohibited-behaviors.name: Silent Paraphrase
prohibited-behaviors.description: Rewriting source text to sound cleaner while changing meaning
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: output sentence diverges from source by more than stopword substitution

prohibited-behaviors.name: Rule Extrapolation
prohibited-behaviors.description: Deriving rules, implications, or corollaries not explicitly stated in the source
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: rule statement with no direct source citation

prohibited-behaviors.name: Version Fabrication
prohibited-behaviors.description: Citing version numbers, dates, or revision histories not in the source
prohibited-behaviors.detection-pattern: version number or date claim without source reference
